evidence.claim: Traydstream provides an AI-powered trade execution, financing, and risk management platform for banks, financial institutions, and corporates, supporting specific modules like TraydCheck, TraydAccess, TraydAnalytics, TraydConnect, TraydFund, and TraydGuard (Traydstream Solutions).
The platform processes over $350bn+ in transactions across more than 70 countries and supports over 800+ document types (Traydstream Home).

TraydCheck automates verification of trade documents against UCP 600 and ISBP 745 international standards with over 400,000 rule permutations using built-in legal and compliance checks (YouTube Video and TraydCheck Solution).

It integrates third-party compliance providers for real-time sanction screening, dual-use goods checks, and transaction banking anti-money laundering (TBML) detection, achieving up to 99.98% discrepancy accuracy (Financial IT and Traydstream & Surecomp Partnership).

Traydstream features native integration with leading global financial systems, partnering with providers like Surecomp to connect its AI engine directly into the RIVO platform (Traydstream & Surecomp Partnership).
The "TraydConnect" solution links exporters, importers, and banks to eliminate redundant processing and allow secure collaboration across the trade ecosystem (Trade for Prosperity).

The core engine utilizes a cloud-native architecture built entirely on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Microsoft's Vision platform for high-performance Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to convert unstructured data (YouTube Video and Fintech Futures).

Deployed at enterprise scale globally by institutions like Deutsche Bank and Standard Bank Group, the platform processes millions of documents securely with automated backend integrations (Traydstream & Deutsche Bank Strategic Partnership and Traydstream for Banks).

In 2026, Traydstream expanded its roadmap to focus heavily on agentic AI operating models capable of autonomously interpreting documents, validating discrepancies, and running compliance assessments (Traydstream News).
The platform rolled out its 2.0 version featuring enhanced speed, updated machine learning classification models, and augmented workability checks across all underlying trade papers (Financial IT).

The company reports its AI-powered platform automates and digitizes trade document checking by validating structured and unstructured data against more than 250,000 global trade and compliance rules, specifically verifying transaction terms for letters of credit and collections.

The company reports its modular solutions include TraydCheck for automated document verification, TraydAccess for managing trade finance asset distribution, and TraydLC Review which targets specific innovations in export letter of credit workability, admin configuration, and mismatch detection.

evidence.claim: Premium Technology provides its flagship FinShare unified platform offering modules including Accounts Receivable Finance, FCI-Enabled Factoring, Distributor Finance, Pre-Shipment Financing, Asset-Based Lending, Supplier Finance, and Dynamic Discounting (Premium Technology Products).

The platform incorporates risk distribution, syndication, Islamic financing, and traditional trade finance features like Letters of Credit, Letters of Guarantee, and Documentary Collections (Premium Technology Products).

FinShare includes a dedicated document management and workflow engine that supports electronic uploading, submission, storage, and status tracking for documents like PDFs, Word files, and images (Premium Technology Trade Finance).

The platform reduces manual activities and cuts average transaction processing times from two days to under one day while meeting multi-level security standards including SOC II Type 2 certification and ISO 27001 audits (Premium Technology Home and Premium Technology Platform).

The platform connects banks, corporates, buyers, and suppliers globally, currently supporting over 50,000 corporate clients across 100+ countries and processing over 50 million transactions monthly (Premium Technology LinkedIn).

FinShare earned official SWIFT certification as a Supply Chain Finance software application, fully supporting the SWIFT Trade Services Utility (TSU) and the Bank Payment Obligation (BPO) standard (Finextra).

FinShare features a centralized database architecture with end-to-end straight-through processing (STP) capabilities from ERP system connectivity all the way to final payment settlement (Premium Technology Products).

The technology acts as enterprise-grade working capital infrastructure deployed directly inside tier-1 global institutions, such as Hatton National Bank's custom "TxB ValueX" ecosystem launched in 2026 (YesPress Feature).

Premium Technology's continuous development focuses on Deep-Tier Finance driven by proprietary ePay token transfers that scale working capital access down to long-tail Tier-2 and nth-tier vendors (Premium Technology Deep Tier Finance).

The company has integrated ESG-linked financing models into its platform to align corporate supply chains with global sustainability frameworks, showcasing these capabilities at enterprise events with partners like SMBC (Premium Technology LinkedIn Post).

The company reports that its FinShare platform supports a wide array of trade finance and supply chain finance instruments, including letters of credit, letters of guarantee, documentary collections, remittance, risk participation, factoring, and supplier finance.

The company reports that the FinShare platform features multi-currency processing, supports conventional and Islamic trade finance, and provides multilingual deployment including English, Chinese, and Vietnamese.
